query: I have a 60-year-old male ICU patient. Among male ICU patients aged 55–65, what is the interquartile range of each patient's maximum heart rate recorded during their ICU stay?
final_sql: SELECT (percentile_cont(0.75) within GROUP (ORDER BY max_heart_rate) - percentile_cont(0.25) within GROUP (ORDER BY max_heart_rate)) AS interquartile_range FROM male_icu_patients;
